# Dental NKT - World-Class Boutique Clinic Hanoi

> World-class dental care & authentic Vietnamese hospitality in Hanoi. Specialist clinic targeting international patients (particularly Australia/NZ) seeking Dental Implants, Porcelain Veneers, and All-on-4 restorations.
